ideas.pitch: A mobile and web platform for rural Gram Panchayats in Bihar to track water infrastructure assets, pump repairs, and Jal Jeev Mission funds transparently.
ideas.title: JalGram: Panchayat Water Asset Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Sustainable Development track and aligns with government-backed rural infrastructure priorities supported by the District Industries Centre, Sheikhpura.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web app helping local farmers in Sheikhpura log harvest yields, connect directly with cold storage units, and eliminate middlemen markups.
ideas.title: KrishiChain: Farmer-to-Processor Supply Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Agriculture domain perfectly by solving a local supply chain inefficiency with a practical, low-bandwidth interface suitable for rural deployment.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web dashboard that processes drone-captured RGB imagery to generate quick NDVI vegetation indices and spot dry crop patches for local farmers.
ideas.title: DroneScan: Crop Health & Irrigation Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Drone Tech and Agriculture domains simultaneously by turning raw aerial data into an actionable dashboard within an 8-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: A voice-enabled diagnostic assistant that lets rural patients record symptoms in local languages to receive preliminary risk assessments and clinic matching.
ideas.title: SwasthyaAI: Multilingual Rural Telemedicine Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Modern Healthcare with localized accessibility, catering directly to the regional health monitoring priorities of district administration judges.

ideas.pitch: A progressive web app enabling vocational training centers in rural districts to track student attendance, module completion, and certificate issuance offline.
ideas.title: KushalShiksha: Offline Skill Development Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Smart Education domain by addressing digital learning and skill development infrastructure gaps in tier-3 districts of India.
